citations.assessment: This parallel supplies the wording “grandson of Rav Huna, son of R. Yirmeyah bar Abba.”
Dialogue identifies Mari son of Huna son of Yirmeyah. Preserve the three parasangs, Barnish, synagogue and Rav’s rule about huts.
Mari’s long patronymic and report in Yoḥanan’s name are both explicit; studenthood remains separately contested.
